note: One source for printer, filament and printed-joint values. CAD (splitting, coupons), the Rust stress check and the print planner all read this file. Estimated values are replaced by measured ones only through `sim-print promote` (see library/printing/README.md).

build_mm.source: Bambu Lab H2C technical specifications (bambulab.com/en/h2c/specs): left nozzle alone 325×320×320 (single-material jobs); both nozzles 300×320×325; total 330×320×325. Use the dual box for two-material pieces.

margin_mm.source: Clearance from the build-volume edges for the skirt; parts on a plate are spaced separately.

nozzle_mm.source: Standard hardened 0.4 mm nozzle as shipped.

line_width_mm.source: Bambu Studio default outer wall line width for a 0.4 mm nozzle.

travel_overhead.source: Share of print time spent on travel, acceleration and layer changes beyond pure extrusion; to be fitted against Bambu Studio slice times.

layer_change_s.source: Time per layer change (retract, z hop, wipe).

margin_mm.source: Clearance from the build-volume edges for the skirt.
Clearance from the build-volume edges for the skirt.

travel_overhead.source: Bed-slinger: slower accelerations than the H2C.

modulus_in_layer.source: Typical 100%-solid FDM PLA along the layers; not measured on this printer.

modulus_across_layers.source: Across the layers, about 80% of the in-layer value (partly fused layer interfaces).

shear_modulus.source: E/(2(1+ν)) from the in-layer modulus, reduced for layer interfaces.

tensile_in_layer.source: Typical published solid FDM PLA along the layers (40–55 MPa).

tensile_across_layers.source: Layer adhesion: typical published FDM PLA pulled across the layers (15–35 MPa); the weakest direction of a print.

interlayer_shear.source: Shear along a layer interface; the value the heat-set insert lesson uses (15–20 MPa).

in_layer_shear.source: Shear within a layer, about 0.6 of tensile.

bearing.source: Bearing failure pressure of a steel pin or screw head on printed PLA (typical pin-bearing tests 35–60 MPa). A failure value: safety factors are applied on top.

glass_transition_c.source: Typical PLA; strength falls sharply above it.

max_volumetric_speed.source: Bambu Studio's default max volumetric speed for PLA Basic on a 0.4 mm nozzle.

filament_price_per_kg.source: Typical spool price, for cost estimates only.

modulus_across_layers.source: PETG layers fuse better than PLA's: about 90% of in-layer.

tensile_across_layers.source: Typical published FDM PETG across layers (better adhesion than PLA).

bearing.source: Bearing failure pressure of a steel pin or screw head on printed PETG (typical tests 30–50 MPa). A failure value: safety factors are applied on top.

modulus_exponent.source: Gibson–Ashby-type scaling E/E₀ = ρ^n between stretch (n=1) and bending (n=2) dominated lattices; gyroid infill tests report about 1.5–1.8.

strength_exponent.source: σ/σ₀ = ρ^m, Gibson–Ashby cellular solids (m = 1.5 for bending-dominated cells).

modulus_exponent.source: Grid infill is partly stretch-dominated in the printing plane.

slip_clearance_mm.source: Added to the pin diameter on the slip side of a seam (a vertical hole on an H2C-class printer).

press_clearance_mm.source: Press side: the hole is 0.05 mm under the pin, so the pin stays in its first piece.

engagement_per_diameter.source: Depth of each hole, as a multiple of the pin diameter.

angle_deg.source: Flank angle from the pull direction, as in the dovetail lesson.

sliding_clearance_mm.source: Per flank, for a rail that slides in by hand.

friction.source: PLA on PLA, as in the dovetail lesson.

grip_share.source: Share of the knurl cylinder that grips melted plastic, as in the heat-set insert lesson.

heat_set_insert.source: Typical brass heat-set insert dimensions (hole, depth, knurl diameter, length); check the maker's sheet for the inserts you buy.

screw.source: ISO 273 medium clearance holes, ISO 4762 socket heads; proof loads for class 8.8 steel (tensile stress area × 580 MPa, rounded).

test_plan.design_value: mean − 2·std (a lower value used for design; with n < 10 the spread is itself uncertain)

history.change: First registry: printers from maker specifications; PLA and PETG values estimated from typical published FDM data; nothing measured on the user's printer yet.
